initialExam.title: TNPSC Group 2 & 2A Services 2026
initialExam.description: TNPSC Group 2 exam for middle-level administrative posts in Tamil Nadu government including Sub-Registrar, Municipal Commissioner, and Probation Officer.
initialExam.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree from a recognized university
initialExam.syllabus: General Studies (75Q), Tamil/English (25Q), Aptitude & Mental Ability (25Q), General Tamil/English (25Q). Total 150 questions, 300 marks.
initialExam.examPattern: Single paper: 150 questions, 300 marks, 3 hours. Objective type. Negative marking: 1/3 mark.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Exam → Certificate Verification → Counselling → Final Allotment
initialExam.jobRole: Sub-Registrar, Municipal Commissioner, Probation Officer, Project Officer
initialExam.careerGrowth: Sub-Registrar → District Registrar → Inspector General of Registration.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit tnpsc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, Medical, Pension

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years
